functions.label: Spirit damage
functions.question: Confirm damage instances, scaling and barrier timing.

functions.label: Bullet / weapon damage
functions.question: Separate weapon damage from spirit riders and on-hit effects.

functions.label: Melee damage
functions.question: Check melee classification, parryability and follow-up timing.

functions.label: Damage type unresolved
functions.question: Resolve missing damage type from raw fields or current client; Spirit scaling alone is insufficient.

functions.label: Damage over time
functions.question: Check removal eligibility, reapplication and ultimate exceptions.

functions.label: Delayed / charged damage
functions.question: Check activation window and whether this cast can actually be interrupted.

functions.label: Stun
functions.question: Confirm ability rank, duration and proc ordering; do not promise a parry.

functions.label: Sleep
functions.question: Check wake-up and follow-up timing; sleep does not imply interruption.

functions.label: Silence
functions.question: Distinguish silence from stun and item-use restrictions.

functions.label: Immobilize
functions.question: Confirm movement restriction and removal exceptions.

functions.label: Pull / knockback / launch
functions.question: Check displacement directly; immunity or barrier triggers cannot be inferred from movement.

functions.label: Movement slow
functions.question: Separate movement slow, dash restrictions and ability lockout.

functions.label: Disarm
functions.question: Check attack and item-use limits separately.

functions.label: Movement / stamina restriction
functions.question: Determine which movements or abilities are blocked and when removal is allowed.

functions.label: Channeled ability
functions.question: Test interruption eligibility, immunity and line-of-sight rules.

functions.label: Healing / regeneration / lifesteal
functions.question: Check recipient, delivery, overlap and whether the effect is healing rather than a shield or deferral.

functions.label: Barrier
functions.question: Investigate barrier-specific responses; healing reduction is not assumed to affect barriers.

functions.label: Damage protection / avoidance
functions.question: Determine exact protection and duration; do not treat it as healing.

functions.label: Dash / flight / teleport
functions.question: Research delivery, range and immunity; mobility is not a single interruptible effect.

functions.label: Stealth / vision denial
functions.question: Research detection and vision mechanics before proposing item responses.

functions.label: Damage amplification / resist reduction
functions.question: Separate direct damage from stacking amplification and check removal eligibility.

functions.label: Execute / threshold kill
functions.question: Direct current interaction evidence is required; ordinary barriers are not execute protection.

functions.label: Special control / rules
functions.question: Resolve the unique effect rather than mapping its name to stun, cleanse or immunity.

functions.label: Summons / deployables
functions.question: Check targetability, damage type and which item effects interact with summons.

functions.label: Healing suppression
functions.question: Check whether the debuff can be removed; this is not evidence of enemy healing.
